description: TanStack AI chat with one tool call, traced by OpenInference's TanStack AI middleware.
notes: @tanstack/ai 1.5.0 with the OpenAI adapter @tanstack/ai-openai 1.1.1, traced by OpenInference's middleware @arizeai/openinference-tanstack-ai 0.3.5. Only openInferenceMiddleware is on the chat call; TanStack's own otelMiddleware is not. The adapter calls the Responses API at the mock, streamed. The tool is read_file(path), a server tool that reads the file from the working directory. The mock answers the first model call with the tool call and the second with text. Expected: ai.chat (agent), ai.llm 1 (llm, tokens 82/17, cost computed), ai.tool read_file (tool, with arguments and result) and ai.llm 2 (llm, tokens 131/12, cost computed). The root carries no token counts, so nothing is counted twice. Volatile: tanstack.ai.request.id, tanstack.ai.stream.id and the iteration events' tanstack.ai.message.id are TanStack's timestamp-and-random ids. Timing: tanstack.ai.duration_ms and tanstack.ai.tool.duration_ms are measured durations. No telemetry leaves the process: the mock is the only host.
